notes.title: [1206]Optimization of Early Game Experience and Difficulty, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Version：3.0.0.2

Experience Optimization:
1. The initial talent points have been increased from 10 to 20, with the default cap raised to 41.
2. The reward for clearing the true ending, "Heroic Hymn," has been adjusted from adding 1 talent point to adding 2.
3. Talent Plate adjustments: Players will now start with 4 gourds and basic refinement abilities, along with instant health regeneration.
- Original gourd talent effects modified to +1/+2.
- Refinement talent effects modified to refinement effect +0.5%/1%.
- Mask Medicine modified to "One More Gourd," granting a 25% chance not to consume a "Gourd" when used.
4. Optimized the overall difficulty curve for Wood Rat Line and reduced the AI difficulty for the minor boss "QingYi" in the "Chapter Of Pig ."
5. Adjusted the drop rate of Orange Soul for both minor and major bosses.
6. Strengthened the guidance for the Talisman system for newcomers.
7. Reduced the chance of Blue Soul Rooms appearing and increased the chance of Reward Rooms appearing.
8. Increased the appearance rate of Ultimate Echoes(talisman).
9. Modified the skills or effects of "Thundering Palm" , "Empyreal Ice", "True Fire of Samadhi" , "Unyielding Swords" , "Rekindled Spirit", "Double Fall", "Reversal" , "Righteous Wind" , and "Final Stand" for improved versatility.
10. Further weakened the Green Self-Destructing enemies, removed their poison upon death, reduced their explosion radius, and made them no longer explode upon death.
11. Adjusted the Shield Mage's shield duration to 5 seconds and removed the re-shielding effect after killing a mage.
12. Added an attack range indicator for the Purple Blade skill of the Divine Empress.
13. Auto-lock for red Talisman. 
14. Modified the numbers of Orange Soul for upgrades.
15. The first stage of the (Wolf Chapter) will no longer feature the "Giant Flower Ghost".

Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed a bug where the player's animation direction would become stuck.
2. Fixed a bug where tthe Minor bosses will now properly drop Orange Soul.
3. Corrected an issue with "Feng Yin" and "Slave General" where the next stage wouldn't provide rewards.
4. Optimized the quick Talisman dissolution text and added Orange Soul gain prompts.
5. Soul jars in Soul Rooms now correctly receive increased Blue Soul gain bonuses.
